scenarios.title: Step5-1 主服务 SIGKILL：C04 真进程矩阵四 barrier（提交前/OC受理后/结果落库后/lease 丢失），记录恢复路由、主 Run 终态、prompt POST 计数、旧 epoch late result/event 双拒
Step5-2 OC 崩溃 + 持久快照恢复：真 SIGKILL serve（非正常退出）→ 同数据目录重启 → C05 生产 localCraftSnapshotSource 恢复（逐文件 sha256 校验、同 OC session 原子续历史、旧版本字节不变）→ 恢复后第二轮真实执行，prompt 计数恰 2 无重发
Step5-3 sandbox 删除：C05 会话链从 serve 删除后按快照恢复/不可恢复语义 + O03 lifecycle sweep 全量（tombstone 顺序、stranded-deleting 重驱、四保护、generation 保护、provider 删除重试）
Step5-4 存储失败：受控存储上传失败 → 整轮零版本发布（W01 不可变发布语义），已传对象留给 O03 延迟回收
Step5-5 两 worker 抢占（SQLite）：真 SIGKILL crash 矩阵 9 boundary + 两 worker lease/epoch 抢占 + 恢复准入门
Step5-5b 两 worker 抢占（PostgreSQL）：自建一次性容器 craft-o05-pgdrill（paradedb pg17，127.0.0.1:45432，跑后已精确删除）上真 SIGKILL 矩阵 8 boundary + 两 worker 抢占；现役 WeKnora-* 容器零接触
Step5-6 浏览器断网：W06 全真栈（craft-stack.sh，端口 42401-42408）craft-reconnect.spec.ts 2/2——刷新/杀流后 syncing 横幅、快照权威状态、恢复后无二次 admission（agent_runs=1）
Step5-7 decision 竞争：决断保存后进程死亡/已接受未 ack 死亡不重复投递 + 被取代决断拒绝（R06 真库）
Step5-8 usage 迟到：unknown 不折 0、迟到修正 revision 替换当前视图（服务层+视图层）
Step5-9 预算不足：最后配额并发授权恰一通过、未注资租户拒绝新调用、过期/撤销 grant 拒绝且已准入持有保留
Step5-10 预览越权：跨租户 404、过期票据 404、路径穿越拒绝、只服务绑定版本、未支持 kind 拒绝、origin 未配置 fail-closed
Step7 旧 builtin 回归：internal/handler/session 全包（旧聊天 run/知识问答/旧产物下载/终端权限）+ MCP 审批 4 测试
Step7 后端相关包：craft/service/repository/container/handler-session/metrics/opencode/agent-runtime 全绿 + recoverytest 全包（TestSkillPythonVerifier 为 BASE 既有本机 venv 环境失败，按惯例 skip）（包级运行以退出码为判据）
Step7 共享 TS + web 构建：test:shared 130/130、typecheck:web 0 错误、web tsc -b && vite build 成功
Step7 Craft E2E 全开矩阵（CRAFT_KINDS=web,document,spreadsheet,slides）：report 6 + document 4 + spreadsheet 4 + slides 4 全过
Step7 默认 fail-closed 矩阵（默认 CRAFT_KINDS=web）：report 6 过、spreadsheet/slides 各 4 过（04 走 503 门禁分支）、document 4 诚实跳过

capabilities.name: core
capabilities.summary: The default release combination: PostgreSQL business database (crash matrix + two-worker contention proven on a self-hosted paradedb/pg17 with real SIGKILL) and the Docker craft runtime images (weknora-craft-runtime, digests locked in docker/craft/*.lock).

capabilities.name: sqlite
capabilities.summary: Single-node SQLite combination, separately proven: the full migration chain, the crash matrix, the O05 drills and the entire browser stack (Go server on SQLite) run on it.

capabilities.name: cube
capabilities.summary: Cube sandbox provider has no craft-specific runtime evidence (R03 bound the craft sandbox to the local/docker path); it stays out of the released combination until a dedicated matrix exists.
capabilities.reason: No craft-on-cube execution evidence exists; conservative wait - do not enable in WEKNORA_CRAFT_* deployment until a drill matrix equivalent to drill-05/05b is produced.

capabilities.name: e2b
capabilities.summary: E2B sandbox provider has no craft-specific runtime evidence; same conservative posture as cube.
capabilities.reason: No craft-on-e2b execution evidence exists; conservative wait - do not enable until a dedicated drill matrix is produced.

capabilities.name: commercial
capabilities.summary: Paid craft release is blocked by the G4 external gap until the commercial schema side lands (see limitations); CanRelease(f, paid=true) fails while Billing=false.
capabilities.reason: commercial_reservations migration lacks the owner column and 4 commercial tables exist only via AutoMigrate; O02 review marks paid rollout blocked until the G4 side completes. Gateway unwired, so the usage ledger is empty.

limitations: G4 外部缺口（收费上线被 O02 审查标记 blocked）：commercial_reservations 迁移缺 owner 列；settlement_records / task_budget_extensions / recovery_audit / fulfillment_records 四张商业表仅存在于 AutoMigrate，无版本化迁移——付费发布在补齐前不可开（Billing=false，CanRelease(paid) 拒绝）
O02 受控模型网关（model gateway）未接线：模型 baseURL 未指向网关、网关路由未挂载，真实链路无物理调用落账，usage 端点如实返回 0/0（诚实空账本，非伪造）
/metrics 端点未暴露：O04 六项低基数指标目前为进程内 CraftMetricsSnapshot()+日志形态，Prometheus 抓取需后续暴露端点（须延续封闭词表纪律）
沙箱驻留事件无生产记录者：RecordSandboxEvent/RecordStorageBytes 仅测试调用（本地单机运行时不铸造远端沙箱），residency 恒为空/0——接口与单测齐备，归属 runtime/沙箱任务
本地单 serve 部署的快照恢复要求 OC 会话在 serve 持久数据中仍存在：会话真丢失时恢复按设计 ErrUnsupported（fail-closed 不伪造）；容器化远端沙箱由源端口替换后语义不变
TestSkillPythonVerifier 为 BASE 既有本机 venv 环境失败（R03/R05/R06/C04 报告在案），与本功能无关，按既有惯例 skip
opencode 上游 48-bit messageID 环回窗口（R01 记录）：executor 已防护（窗口外 id 不重发），但长期运营需随上游升级重估
D03 截图像素级人工验收为既定 not_run 通道（N3），机器断言（SVG 文本/页数/图表几何）已全覆盖
